channel.title: LeafCraftPRO — Craft Guides
channel.description: Handmade natural crafts and step-by-step tutorials woven from palm and coconut leaves.

item.title: 20 Handmade Gift Ideas Woven from Natural Leaves
item.description: Twenty handmade gift ideas woven from palm and coconut leaves, grouped by occasion and skill level, with realistic making times for each one.

item.title: How to Weave a Basket Base: Square, Round and Oval
item.description: A reference guide to the three basket base shapes - square, round and oval - with the weave, strip count and time each one needs to get right.

item.title: Large Palm Leaf Storage Basket with Rope Handles
item.description: A big palm leaf storage basket, 40 cm across and 30 cm tall, with thick rope handles. The biggest project on the site, and the most useful once it is done.

item.title: Rainy Day Nature Crafts for Kids to Make Indoors
item.description: Nature crafts for a wet afternoon: a store of dried leaves, a few simple projects and one longer woven bowl to keep children busy when you cannot get outside.

item.title: Natural Table Decor Ideas with Woven Palm Leaves
item.description: Six ways to style a table with woven leaves, from a simple place mat to a hanging centrepiece, with sizes and a note on keeping them food-safe.

item.title: What Happens When a Leaf Craft Goes Back to the Earth
item.description: A factual look at how woven leaf crafts biodegrade, what speeds up or slows down composting, and why a coating or a synthetic thread changes everything.

item.title: Woven Mini Bag Tutorial from Palm Leaves Step by Step
item.description: A full tutorial for a woven mini bag from palm leaves. Build a square base, weave tight walls, and finish a neat rim and handle in about two hours.

item.title: How to Make a Leaf Crown with Children at Home
item.description: A woven leaf crown that fits a child's head and survives a whole afternoon of play. Real measurements, age guidance and safety notes for the whole project.

item.title: Coconut Leaf Bracelets and Bands You Can Wear
item.description: Weave a coconut leaf bracelet in about twenty minutes. A simple three-strand plait that becomes a wearable band, sized to your own wrist.

item.title: How to Prepare and Soften Palm Leaves for Weaving
item.description: Everything that happens before the weaving: choosing leaves, stripping the spine, cutting even strips, softening dry leaf and storing what you do not use.

item.title: Where to Source Palm and Coconut Leaves for Weaving
item.description: Practical places to find palm and coconut leaves for weaving, how to gather them responsibly, and how to tell fresh, usable leaves from ones that will crack.

item.title: Palm Leaf Fish Craft for Kids to Make at Home
item.description: A folded palm leaf fish that children can make in twenty minutes with a single strip. Age guidance, safety notes and the exact folds, step by step.

item.title: 12 Useful Home Crafts You Can Weave from Palm Leaves
item.description: Twelve things worth making for the home, from a fifteen-minute coaster to a laundry basket, each with a rough size, time and skill level.

item.title: Coconut Leaf Decorations for Festivals and Parties
item.description: Nine coconut leaf decorations you can make for festivals and parties, from garlands and bunting to hanging stars and table runners. All from one frond.

item.title: A Beginner's Guide to Sustainable Crafting at Home
item.description: A practical starting guide to sustainable crafting: choosing materials, avoiding the common greenwash traps, and the small habits that actually reduce waste.

item.title: 15 Easy Leaf Crafts for Kids to Make at Home Today
item.description: Fifteen leaf crafts for children, from ten-minute projects to a whole afternoon. Age guidance, safety notes and real materials for every single one.

item.title: Natural Palm Leaf Placemats for a Slow Table
item.description: A set of four natural palm leaf placemats, 35 cm by 25 cm, woven flat and pressed crisp. A calm weekend project that upgrades every meal you eat.

item.title: Palm Leaf Sun Hat: A Step by Step Weaving Guide
item.description: A wide-brim palm leaf sun hat with a crown shaped over a bowl. Breathable, light, and finished so the brim keeps its shape even after rain.

item.title: How to Style Woven Baskets in Every Room of the Home
item.description: A styling guide, not a tutorial: where to place woven baskets, what size to choose for each room, and the two rules that stop them looking cluttered.

item.title: How to Care for Woven Crafts So They Last for Years
item.description: A practical care guide for woven crafts: cleaning, drying, storing and repairing palm and coconut leaf pieces so they stay strong for years rather than months.

item.title: Make a Palm Leaf Lampshade That Casts Beautiful Shadows
item.description: An open-weave palm leaf lampshade that throws a warm pattern of light across the wall. Sized for a standard pendant fitting and made in an afternoon.

item.title: Small Coconut Leaf Basket for Gifts and Favours
item.description: Weave a small coconut leaf basket for gifts and favours in about ninety minutes. A tidy beginner basket with a folded rim and a simple handle.

item.title: Palm Leaf Christmas Decorations to Make at Home
item.description: Warm, natural Christmas decorations woven from palm leaves: stars, trees and baubles that smell faintly of the garden and cost almost nothing to make.

item.title: Weave a Large Laundry Basket from Natural Fibres
item.description: A big round laundry basket, 45 cm across and 40 cm tall, sturdy enough to carry a full load. Built from palm, banana leaf and a little rope.

item.title: Woven Palm Leaf Serving Tray Tutorial
item.description: A shallow woven palm leaf serving tray with a raised rim and two handholds, sturdy enough for breakfast in bed. A two-hour project with real measurements.

item.title: Fold a Coconut Leaf Star Ornament in Fifteen Minutes
item.description: A quick five-point coconut leaf star you can fold in fifteen minutes. Perfect for garlands, gift toppers and simple Christmas tree ornaments.

item.title: Palm Leaf vs Plastic: An Honest Comparison for Homes
item.description: An honest comparison of palm leaf and plastic homeware: lifespan, water resistance, cost, hygiene and end of life, including the cases where plastic genuinely wins.

item.title: How to Weave a Fruit Basket with a Flared Rim
item.description: A wide, shallow fruit basket about 30 cm across, with a rim that flares out so the fruit sits low and looks generous. Two hours and ten leaves.

item.title: Why Natural Materials Make Better Home Objects
item.description: A balanced look at what natural materials genuinely do better in the home, where they fall short, and when plastic is honestly the smarter choice.

item.title: Handmade Palm Leaf Coasters in 20 Minutes
item.description: Four strips, twenty minutes, and a set of six handmade palm leaf coasters. The fastest useful thing you can weave, plus how to make them match.
